# opencode daemon

A process manager for opencode, built with bun and opentui.

## Commands

### `ocd`/`ocd new` - create or reuse a project server and start a session.

| Arg               | Description                                          |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `path`            | Project path. Defaults to current working directory. |
| `--session`/`-s`  | Reuse explicit session id.                           |
| `--continue`/`-c` | Continue latest root session.                        |
| `--attach`/`-a`   | Attach immediately after resolving session.          |

### `ocd list` - list all tracked project servers.

| Arg      | Description                                     |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| _(none)_ | This command has no positional args or options. |

This command is also available via the global flag: `ocd --list`.

`ocd list`/`ocd --list` prints each tracked instance with status, endpoint, and all attached sessions including busy/idle state and session title (from the OpenCode `/session` API).

### `ocd top` - show project resource usage.

| Arg                              | Description                                          |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `path`                           | Project path. Defaults to current working directory. |
| `--tui`/`-t`                     | Launch top in Solid/OpenTUI view.                    |
| `--watch`/`-w`                   | Continuously refresh top output.                     |
| `--intervalMs`/`--interval`/`-i` | Sampling interval in milliseconds.                   |

In `--tui` mode, instances are shown as pages (one instance per view). Keyboard:
- `j`/`k` (or `down`/`up`) to move to next/previous instance page
- `h`/`l` (or `left`/`right`) to horizontally scroll the command column
- `H`/`L` for faster horizontal command scrolling
- `r` refresh, `q`/`esc`/`ctrl+c` quit

### `ocd attach` - attach to project server in native OpenCode UI.

| Arg              | Description                                          |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `path`           | Project path. Defaults to current working directory. |
| `--session`/`-s` | Attach specific session id.                          |
| `--latest`/`-l`  | Attach latest root session.                          |

### `ocd stop` - stop one project server or all servers.

| Arg                   | Description                                          |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `path`                | Project path. Defaults to current working directory. |
| `--all`/`-a`          | Stop every tracked project server.                   |
| `--graceMs`/`--grace` | Grace period before SIGKILL.                         |

### `ocd restart` - restart one project server.

| Arg                   | Description                                          |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `path`                | Project path. Defaults to current working directory. |
| `--graceMs`/`--grace` | Grace period before SIGKILL.                         |
| `--continue`/`-c`     | Continue latest root session after restart.          |
| `--attach`/`-a`       | Attach immediately after restart.                    |

### `ocd gc` - prune stale entries and idle servers.

| Arg                      | Description                   |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------- |
| `--idleMinutes`/`--idle` | Idle cutoff in minutes.       |
| `--orphan`               | Remove dead registry entries. |

### `ocd status` - show project health.

| Arg                              | Description                                          |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `path`                           | Project path. Defaults to current working directory. |
| `--watch`/`-w`                   | Continuously refresh status output.                  |
| `--intervalMs`/`--interval`/`-i` | Refresh interval in milliseconds.                    |

## Development

To install dependencies:

```bash
bun install
```

To run:

```bash
bun run src/index.ts
```

To build a standalone binary:

```bash
bun run build:bin
```

To copy the bin to `~/.local/bin`:

```bash
bun run copy
```

To build the binary and copy it to `~/.local/bin`:

```bash
bun run build
```

# OCD Control Plane Plan (Bun-first, OpenTUI-ready)

Date: 2026-02-12
Owner: Zero
Status: MVP complete (hardening items pending)

## Objective

Build `ocd` as a control plane over OpenCode so each project has a managed server lifecycle (`serve` + `attach`), session reuse, and resource visibility (especially LSP/PTY pressure) with a clean path to future OpenTUI UI.

## Scope and Success Criteria

- Single command surface: `ocd new/list/top/attach/stop/gc/status`.
- One managed OpenCode server per normalized project path.
- Deterministic attach/reuse behavior for sessions.
- Resource visibility from daemon side (server + children + PTY + LSP status).
- Core logic UI-agnostic so Solid/OpenTUI can bind later without refactor.

## Catalog + Upstream Research (from subagent)

- `~/.library-catalog/typescript/anomalyco.opencode` was synced from `022265829` -> `d86f24b6b`.
- Repo verified aligned with `origin/dev` (`0 0` behind/ahead).
- Full `catalog status` timed on entire catalog; repo-local verification used as source of truth.

## OpenCode Architecture References We Will Build Against

- Server app shape and route mounting: `packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts:57`, `packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts:227`.
- Directory scoping precedence (`query.directory` -> header `x-opencode-directory` -> cwd): `packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts:197`.
- Per-directory instance cache keyed by raw directory string: `packages/opencode/src/project/instance.ts:22`.
- Instance context bootstraps LSP/file watcher/snapshot/plugins: `packages/opencode/src/project/bootstrap.ts:17`.
- Instance SSE (`/event`): `packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts:486`.
- Global SSE (`/global/event`) with `{directory,payload}`: `packages/opencode/src/server/routes/global.ts:42`.
- Headless server command entrypoint: `packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/serve.ts:7`.
- Attach command with `--dir`, `--session`, `--password`: `packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/tui/attach.ts:24`.

## Practical API/CLI Surface For OCD

- Process control
  - `opencode serve [--port --hostname --mdns --cors]`
  - `opencode attach <url> --dir <path> --session <id> --password <pw>`
- Health/context
  - `GET /global/health`
  - `GET /path?directory=...`
  - `GET /project/current?directory=...`
- Sessions
  - `GET /session?directory=...&roots=true&search=&limit=`
  - `POST /session`
  - `GET /session/status`
  - `POST /session/{id}/prompt_async`
- Runtime and streams
  - `GET /event?directory=...`
  - `GET /global/event`
- PTY
  - `GET/POST/DELETE /pty`
  - `GET /pty/{id}`
  - `GET /pty/{id}/connect` (WS)
- Cleanup
  - `POST /instance/dispose`
  - `POST /global/dispose`
- SDK
  - `@opencode-ai/sdk/v2` via `createOpencodeClient({ baseUrl, directory, headers })`

## Known Caveats (must design around)

- `/lsp` exposes status metadata, not PID/cpu/mem.
- `/pty` includes PID (good anchor for attribution).
- SDK `pty.connect` generation behaves as HTTP GET; WS connect may need manual helper.
- `find.symbols` endpoint currently returns empty/stub.
- `OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME` custom values can break flows assuming `opencode` username.
- Instance keying uses raw directory string, so non-canonical paths can duplicate logical instances.
- `POST /global/dispose` disposes instances, does not kill server process.

## OCD Technical Direction

- Architecture: local daemon + CLI wrapper.
- Isolation model: one OpenCode server process per normalized project root.
- State model: durable local registry keyed by canonical path.
- UX model: `new/attach` always route through registry and policy, never ad-hoc direct spawn.
- Metrics model: merge API telemetry (`/lsp`, `/pty`, `/session/status`) + procfs process tree sampling.
- UI model: same daemon API consumed by plain CLI tables now and OpenTUI later.
- CLI contract model: command/flag schemas defined in Zod with human descriptions, then generated parser/help output (yargs-like UX on Bun without hand-writing `--help` docs per flag).

## CLI Schema Strategy (Bun + Zod)

- Use a shared helper that takes a command manifest (`name`, `description`, args schema, options schema, examples).
- Use Zod `.describe()` on each field so `--help` text is auto-derived from schema metadata.
- Parse argv once, then route typed command payload to handlers (no duplicated parsing logic).
- Keep command definitions declarative so future OpenTUI can re-use metadata (labels, defaults, validation).
- Planned modules:
  - `src/cli/schema.ts` - primitives for option/arg schema descriptors.
  - `src/cli/commands.ts` - command registry with Zod schemas + descriptions.
  - `src/cli/help.ts` - renderer for global and command help from schema metadata.
  - `src/cli/parse.ts` - argv parser + validation + typed dispatch payload.

## Command Behavior Spec (MVP)

- `ocd new [path] [--session <id>|--continue]`
  - canonicalize path; ensure server exists; resolve/create session; optionally attach immediately.
- `ocd list`
  - show all registered projects with health, pid, uptime, session counts, busy counts.
- `ocd top`
  - show per-project grouped resource usage (`opencode`, `lsp`, `pty`, `other`) + activity.
- `ocd attach [path] [--session <id>|--latest]`
  - resolve existing server and session, then exec `opencode attach` with dir/password.
- `ocd stop [path|--all] [--grace 5s]`
  - dispose instance(s), send SIGTERM then SIGKILL on grace timeout, unregister.
- `ocd gc [--idle 30m] [--orphan]`
  - prune dead entries; stop idle servers (no busy sessions/PTYS) after threshold.
- `ocd status [path]`
  - deep project status: health, project path/worktree, sessions, busy state, lsp, pty, metrics.

---

## Sprint Plan

### Sprint 1 - Contract + failing tests first

Goal: lock behavior contracts before implementation to avoid CLI/daemon drift.

Technical overview:
- Encode command semantics from this plan into tests first.
- Mock OpenCode API boundaries at HTTP level, not internal implementation.
- Validate scoping and canonical-path behavior because upstream instance keying is raw string (`packages/opencode/src/project/instance.ts:22`).
- Lock CLI interface as schemas first (Zod descriptions must drive generated help text).

Tasks:
- [x] Create `bun test` suite for command contracts: `new/list/top/attach/stop/gc/status`.
- [x] Add failing tests for schema-driven CLI parse/help generation (global + per-command help).
- [x] Add fixture adapters for `/global/health`, `/path`, `/session`, `/session/status`, `/lsp`, `/pty`.
- [x] Add canonical-path tests (same project via symlink/relative/realpath maps to one key).
- [x] Add auth tests for password/username edge behavior.
- [x] Add failure-mode tests: server unavailable, stale pid, broken WS PTY connect.

Deliverable:
- Red test suite documenting expected behavior and edge cases.

### Sprint 2 - Daemon lifecycle + registry core

Goal: reliable process manager for per-project `opencode serve`.

Technical overview:
- Build spawn/health/stop primitives around headless server (`packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/serve.ts:7`).
- Use `GET /global/health` as health gate.
- Persist registry with canonical path key + pid/url/password metadata.
- Implement CLI helper foundation so option docs/help are generated from Zod description metadata.

Tasks:
- [x] Implement shared schema-based CLI helper (`src/cli/schema.ts`, `src/cli/parse.ts`, `src/cli/help.ts`).
- [x] Implement command manifest registry (`src/cli/commands.ts`) for `new/list/top/attach/stop/gc/status`.
- [x] Implement registry storage with atomic writes (`src/daemon/registry.ts`).
- [x] Implement project canonicalization (`src/domain/project.ts`).
- [x] Implement process lifecycle manager (`src/daemon/opencode-process.ts`): spawn, health wait, stop escalation.
- [x] Implement daemon service API (`src/daemon/server.ts`) for CLI calls.
- [x] Implement reconciler loop (`src/daemon/reconciler.ts`) to mark dead pids and recover state.

Deliverable:
- `ocd status` works for one and many projects with durable restart-safe state.

### Sprint 3 - Session policy + attach UX

Goal: deterministic session reuse/create and smooth operator flow.

Technical overview:
- Use `GET /session` + `POST /session` + `GET /session/status` for policy decisions.
- `ocd attach` shells into `opencode attach` with `--dir` and password so user stays in native UI.
- Respect upstream directory scoping precedence (`packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts:197`).

Tasks:
- [x] Implement session selection policy module (`src/domain/session.ts`) for `--session`, `--latest`, `--continue`.
- [x] Implement `ocd new` orchestration: ensure server -> resolve/create session -> optional attach.
- [x] Implement `ocd attach` command execution wrapper with explicit dir/session/password.
- [x] Implement `ocd list` summary fields (session counts, busy states, uptime).
- [x] Add retry/backoff on transient API failures.

Deliverable:
- `ocd new`, `ocd attach`, `ocd list` fully functional and tested end to end.

### Sprint 4 - Metrics pipeline + top view

Goal: actionable resource visibility despite LSP PID API gap.

Technical overview:
- Build Linux procfs sampler to capture server child tree cpu/rss.
- Merge with OpenCode API: `/lsp` state, `/pty` pids, `/session/status` busy signal.
- Attribute groups per project and component class; expose to table renderer and future TUI.

Tasks:
- [x] Implement process tree sampling (`src/metrics/procfs.ts`) with stable cpu delta calculations.
- [x] Implement metrics aggregation model (`src/metrics/model.ts`) for component grouping.
- [x] Implement API enrichers for `/lsp`, `/pty`, `/session/status` correlation.
- [x] Implement `ocd top` CLI table view (`src/ui/table.ts`).
- [x] Add tests for attribution heuristics and missing-data fallback.

Deliverable:
- `ocd top` provides per-project/process visibility with low sampling overhead.

### Sprint 5 - Stop/gc correctness + safety rails

Goal: safe cleanup and garbage collection for long-running use.

Technical overview:
- Use `/instance/dispose` or `/global/dispose` for logical teardown, then OS process termination.
- Confirm no active busy sessions/PTY before idle kill decisions.
- Handle stale registry/orphan processes robustly.

Tasks:
- [x] Implement `ocd stop` with graceful timeout and escalation.
- [x] Implement `ocd gc` with idle policy and orphan pruning.
- [x] Implement lock strategy to prevent duplicate spawn races per project key.
- [ ] Add comprehensive integration tests for multi-process race conditions.
- [ ] Add structured logging/events for operator debugging.

Deliverable:
- Stable long-running lifecycle management with predictable cleanup behavior.

### Sprint 6 - OpenTUI-ready adapter boundary

Goal: freeze internal API boundary so Solid/OpenTUI can plug in cleanly.

Technical overview:
- Keep CLI thin; daemon/domain/metrics as reusable core.
- Add explicit DTOs for status/list/top payloads.
- Add event fanout layer around SSE (`/event`, `/global/event`) for live views.

Tasks:
- [ ] Define shared DTOs and command/query interfaces (`src/types.ts`).
- [ ] Implement event adapter (`src/opencode/events.ts`) with reconnect/backoff semantics.
- [ ] Add WS helper (`src/opencode/ws.ts`) for PTY stream integration.
- [ ] Add UI-facing query service consumed by both table CLI and future OpenTUI.
- [ ] Document OpenTUI integration contract and expected state shape.

Deliverable:
- No-refactor path to Solid/OpenTUI dashboard from existing daemon state.

---

## Proposed Bun Module Layout

- `src/cli.ts` - thin entrypoint, parse + dispatch.
- `src/cli/schema.ts` - Zod schema primitives for args/options.
- `src/cli/commands.ts` - declarative command registry and metadata.
- `src/cli/help.ts` - auto-generated help from schema descriptions.
- `src/cli/parse.ts` - argv validation + typed command payload.
- `src/daemon/server.ts` - local daemon transport.
- `src/daemon/registry.ts` - persistent registry.
- `src/daemon/opencode-process.ts` - spawn/health/stop.
- `src/daemon/reconciler.ts` - heartbeat and gc evaluator.
- `src/opencode/client.ts` - typed SDK wrapper.
- `src/opencode/events.ts` - SSE streaming.
- `src/opencode/ws.ts` - PTY websocket bridge.
- `src/metrics/procfs.ts` - process metrics sampler.
- `src/metrics/model.ts` - attribution + aggregation.
- `src/domain/project.ts` - canonical project identity.
- `src/domain/session.ts` - session policy.
- `src/ui/table.ts` - terminal table rendering.
- `src/ui/tui/` - future OpenTUI app.
- `src/types.ts` - shared types/DTOs.

## Risk Register + Mitigations

- LSP PID gap
  - Mitigation: procfs child attribution now; optional minimal upstream patch later.
- Auth username mismatch
  - Mitigation: default to `opencode` username assumptions unless user opts in; explicit warning.
- Duplicate logical instances from path variants
  - Mitigation: strict realpath normalization before registry/API use.
- Partial dispose semantics
  - Mitigation: always follow dispose with process-state verification and explicit kill path.
- PTY WS generation mismatch in SDK
  - Mitigation: manual WS helper module and integration tests.

## Optional Minimal Upstream Patch Set (if needed later)

- Add `pid` to LSP status payload.
- Add lightweight `/metrics/process` endpoint for server/lsp/pty pid + cpu/rss.
- Ensure username handling is consistent across attach/web/terminal clients.

## Immediate Next Two Execution Steps

- [x] Implement Sprint 1 red tests and fixtures.
- [x] Implement Sprint 2 daemon registry + `ocd status` green path.

## MVP Completion Note

- MVP command surface is implemented and tested: `new/list/top/attach/stop/gc/status`.
- Remaining unchecked bullets in later sprints are hardening/operational polish, not blockers for MVP functionality.
